integrity: The included proof supplies exact all-dimension identities and explicitly positive John-contact weights; the separate standalone script provides reproducible finite checks. Literature searches cannot establish universal priority. No claim of independent audit, external certification, or formal proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the degree-inequality fractional matching polytope of the complete simple graph with canonical edge-coordinate Euclidean metric. It does not solve arbitrary graphs, integral matching polytopes with odd-set inequalities, or metric-rescaled variants. Finite verification does not establish general validity.
title: Exact John ellipsoid of complete-graph fractional matching polytopes
